component.name: Cogvivo
component.summary: Funny challenges and your own buddy in your taskbar

description.p: Cogvivo is a social app full of funny challenges you do in real life, with real monuments near you and your own buddy.

On Linux your buddy lives in your taskbar: in the Ubuntu dock when it sits at the bottom, otherwise in the top bar, and in the bottom panel of other desktops. It rests in the empty spots between your icons, talks, sleeps at night and has its own little house next to your system tray. Your mouse goes right through it, except on your buddy itself, and when a game or video goes full screen it steps aside.

description.p: Updates now arrive by themselves: the .deb and .rpm add the Cogvivo package source, so new versions come with your normal system updates. Without internet, Cogvivo shows your buddy and opens by itself as soon as you are online again.

Your buddy now lives in your taskbar: in the Ubuntu dock when it sits at the bottom, otherwise in the top bar, and in the bottom panel of other desktops. It rests in the empty spots between your icons and has a small house next to your system tray. Clicking your buddy now also works under Wayland, and Cogvivo speaks 24 languages.
Cogvivo for Linux, with your buddy on your desktop.
